name: RC–B10–0156/2025 – § 12 – Am 23
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: 12. Expresses dismay concerning the policy of the US administration of appeasing Russia and targeting its allies; warns that this policy undermines the trust of traditional US allies around the world and can have devastating consequences for the transatlantic bond, peace and stability in Europe and beyond; reiterates the need for strategic independence from the US; rejects attempts by Russia, the US and other powers to influence democracy and the rule of law in Europe;
